findings.rootCause: EDU declares Public profiles/providers but omits the explicitly selected Common Starter and its Batch/Cache/Fixed-Length examples use obsolete nested-enum/accessor names instead of current Public contracts.

Executable Batch applications import Web header, Runtime Control, Kafka and Jackson types without declaring their direct owner dependencies; Scheduler also calls the obsolete three-argument nextBusinessDay overload.

Email and SMS wiring still import the retired com.cpf.notification.dispatch API. SMS additionally contains a duplicate legacy dispatch/sms/spi source and test tree while the catalog/resource owner is com.cpf.notification.sms.

findings.owner: framework web and cpf-testkit maintained tests
findings.rootCause: Two maintained fixtures still invoke a removed 12-argument CpfTransactionContext shape after canonical System and Channel lineage became explicit.
The module omits its direct Mockito test dependency and a validation fixture calls removed helper methods instead of exercising the installer public security boundary.

canonicalDecisions: Do not add compatibility aliases to current Public APIs solely to preserve stale EDU/test call sites.
Declare direct executable-module dependencies at their actual owners; do not rely on accidental transitive classpaths.
Keep com.cpf.notification.sms as the single catalog-owned package and remove only the exact duplicate legacy tree after consumer-zero confirmation.
Retain full System/Channel lineage in Context fixtures.
Test ArtifactInstaller through its public install boundary rather than restoring internal parsing helpers.
